1ioye6z: Sergio has lived in Puebla for eight months. He moved to work at a small company, and at first he thought the adjustment would be over once he learned the way to the office. However, he soon found out that knowing a city isn't only about finding your way around. He missed simple conversations, places where people recognized him, and activities that didn't depend on work.
1wv9tq5: During the first weeks he got nervous every time he had to ask for clarification. He would stay quiet so as not to look lost and then make mistakes he could have avoided. A coworker told him she had also been through a move. She recommended that he choose a regular activity and accept that feeling part of a place takes time. Sergio went back to a drawing workshop and began volunteering at a library on Saturdays.
mn183j: Sergio keeps learning the team's customs and has stopped treating every doubt as a failure. He has started drawing regularly again and has just offered to organize a small show of the workshop.
1w4o571: He has now been taking part in the workshop for five months and has become more patient with his own progress. He doesn't think every move is a wonderful adventure or that difficulties disappear just because you have a good attitude. He still misses his friends and depends on complicated schedules to call them. But he has learned to keep those ties while he builds others. When someone new joins the team, he remembers his first day and offers a concrete explanation before assuming that person already knows how everything works.
